Real-Game Engineering Upgrades Verified in v2.0

1. PendingDeployTracker & Tap-Drop Retry

Remembers tapped cards during the ~1.15s ADB + server spawn delay so the bot never double-commits 7 elixir onto a 3-elixir threat, and automatically retries if emulator lag drops a tap.

2. Kinematic Lead-Time Prediction

Projects moving enemy velocity across ADB + card cast latency so Mega Knight stomps land squarely in front of fast Hog/Ram rushes and Zap catches moving Bats/Skarmy.

3. Exact Goblin Barrel Landing Sync

Drops Goblin Gang immediately (1.0s deploy matches barrel landing) while holding Zap (0.5s cast) until barrel flight age >= 0.48s so Zap never whiffs mid-air—and ignores 10-HP zapped remnants.

4. Bridge Sniper Instant Response

Detects long-range Princess, Magic Archer, Dart Goblin & Siege units at y >= 13.6 outranging our Princess Tower and immediately dispatches bridge Gang / Miner.

5. Splash Discipline & E-Wiz Isolation

Refuses to feed Bats/Gang into Baby Dragon or Wizard splash; pairs opposite-flank Inferno Dragon with direct Miner snipes onto enemy Electro Wizards.

6. Zero Elixir-10 Hand-Locks

Universal anti-deadlock fallback + Beatdown Mega Knight support crush achieved 0.00 leaked elixir per match across all 80 meta games.
